items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So the singer, Wilson Seminal, who sang in that – he came, and he sang.

ctx.x: Did you sing on that concert?

No. It was only Brazilians. So they all came. The movie Black Orpheus had just come out. So the singer, Wilson Seminal, who sang in that – he came, and he sang. He’s a wonderful singer, a great singer.
Okay. We’ll have to pick back up on this tomorrow.
